name: paper-matched settings, 2026-11-12
purpose: Second run of the paper's section 5 experiment with settings matched to the paper's figure legends and Figure 1 curves; replaces the 2026-11-05 run as the presented reproduction
paper: Zhang, Zou, Cao, The Implicit Bias of Adam on Separable Data, NeurIPS 2024, section 5 and Figures 1-2
datasets: results/2026-11-05/datasets (same ten PCG64 datasets, same initial vectors, same selected seed 2)
loss_note: Summed over the 50 samples, not averaged as in eq. 3.1. With averaging, GD at eta = 0.1 lags the paper's Figure 1(b) curve by one to two orders of magnitude in time; with summing it matches from about 100 updates on. Adam with epsilon = 0 is unaffected by this scaling.
gd_gdm_learning_rate_source: Figure 1 legend: GD and GDM with eta_t = 0.1
adam_learning_rate_source: Figure 1 and 2 legends write eta_t = t^-a; the text writes Theta(t^-a). c = 0.1 matches the paper's Figure 1 Adam curve and its Figure 2 ordering of a; c = 1 does not (results/2026-11-12-posthoc).
primary_adam_a_source: Figure 1 legend: Adam with eta_t = t^-0.5
arithmetic: Same common exponential rescaling of the Adam moments as run.py; epsilon kept at its real size (epsilon*e^scale in the rescaled denominator); no clamp
disclosure: The loss scaling and c were chosen after the 2026-11-05 results, by comparison with the paper's published curves. They are not pre-registered. The 2026-11-05 run is kept unchanged.
